description: This is a Java test class for the LoanCOBApiFilter component, specifically testing various filtering and locking scenarios for loan banking operations within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: LoanCOBApiFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of LoanCOBApiFilter in various scenarios including locking, user bypass, and loan status checks.

methods.name: shouldLoanAndExternalMatchToo
methods.description: Tests regex matching and replacement patterns for loan URL paths with different formats, including external IDs.

methods.name: shouldGlimAccountMatch
methods.description: Tests regex matching and replacement patterns specifically for GLIM account URL paths.

methods.name: shouldProceedWhenUrlDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Ensures the filter proceeds normally when the request URL doesn't match known patterns.

methods.name: shouldProceedWhenUrlDoesNotMatchWithInvalidLoanId
methods.description: Checks that the filter proceeds if the provided loan ID in URL is invalid or not found.

methods.name: shouldProceedWhenUserHasBypassPermission
methods.description: Verifies processing when the user has bypass permission, skipping loan checks.

methods.name: shouldProceedWhenLoanIsNotLockedAndNoLoanIsBehind
methods.description: Ensures normal flow if the loan isn't locked and no 'behind' status is detected.

methods.name: shouldProceedWhenExternalLoanIsNotLockedAndNotBehind
methods.description: Ensures flow when external loan ID isn't locked and isn't behind scheduled processing.

methods.name: shouldProceedWhenRescheduleLoanIsNotLockedAndNotBehind
methods.description: Checks the flow when a reschedule request does not lock the loan and no 'behind' status exists.

methods.name: shouldRunInlineCOBAndProceedWhenLoanIsBehind
methods.description: Tests that inline COB execution triggers when the loan is detected as behind schedule based on last closed business date.

methods.name: shouldNotRunInlineCOBAndProceedWhenLoanIsNotBehind
methods.description: Verifies no inline COB execution occurs if the loan is not behind schedule.

methods.name: shouldNotRunInlineCOBAndProceedWhenLoanIsBehindForLoanCreation
methods.description: Checks that inline COB is skipped for loan creation requests, regardless of behind status.

methods.name: shouldNotRunInlineCOBForCatchUp
methods.description: Ensures inline COB is not run during catch-up endpoints.

methods.name: shouldRejectWhenLoanIsHardLocked
methods.description: Tests that a conflict response is sent when the loan is hard locked.

methods.name: shouldRejectWhenGlimLoanIsHardLocked
methods.description: Tests rejection when GLIM loan is in a hard locked state.

methods.name: shouldThrowAuthenticationCredentialsNotFoundException_WhenUnAuthenticatedUserExceptionIsThrown
methods.description: Ensures an exception is thrown if no authenticated user is present during filtering.

methods.name: shouldProceed_WhenAuthenticatedUser
methods.description: Verifies normal proceed if an authenticated user is present and no special conditions prevent flow.
